$comment: Human-owned per-component maturity assignments. This file is the single reconciled source of truth for maturityTier; it is NOT generated. Tiers use the vocabulary defined in docs/component-readiness.md: stable | beta | experimental | internal | deprecated. Entries whose `source` begins with 'inferred:' have no documented tier and are pending human review — see docs/agentic-upgrade-audit.md (D2). Inference never yields 'stable': only a documented tier can grant unsupervised agent use.
$pendingComment: Tier assignments for components that are documented in docs/component-readiness.md but not yet exported from main (the canvas/globe work is still uncommitted). These are parked here so the documented tiers are not re-derived from scratch when that work lands: move them into `components` in the same commit that exports them. Nothing reads this key — registry:check fails if an exported component has no entry under `components`, so the move is enforced.

Revisit after Phase 4.
